reddit.title: Exciting Updates on Water Mechanics in Provincia!
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how water interacts with terrain in Provincia! With our new native sparse flow system, water depth now updates efficiently, allowing for smoother gameplay without freezing the frame. You can shape the land with ditches and wells without any hitches. Check out the full details in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
